The architecture

One banking objective in.
Your entire operation, moving.

Talk to Us

The Lyzr Banking OS sits at the centre of your operations. It reads every signal across customers, transactions, risk and regulation, and closes every loop back to your business and compliance goals.

What does your institution actually need?

The right question changes everything.

Most banking leaders have deployed AI in pockets. The Lyzr Banking OS starts with why those pilots haven’t scaled and what it takes to run an entire institution on agents that are governed from day one.

Your KYC takes weeks. Your competitor onboards in hours.

The Banking OS deploys a continuous, event-driven KYC workflow. Agents verify identity, screen sanctions, assess risk, and update customer profiles in real time. Onboarding compresses from weeks to hours, with every decision logged and explainable to any regulator who asks.

Which fraud flags are genuine, and which cost you customers?

The Banking OS correlates transaction signals, behavioural patterns, device intelligence, and counterparty history into a dynamic risk score per transaction. False positives drop. Genuine fraud catches improve. Every decision is explainable.

Does your compliance posture reflect what’s required right now?

The Banking OS monitors regulatory change across every jurisdiction you operate in: Basel III updates, EU AI Act requirements, PRA guidance, OCC examination scope. It maps each change to your policies, surfaces the gaps, and generates updated controls before the next examination cycle.

Your loan origination involves fifteen manual handoffs.

The Banking OS orchestrates the full credit lifecycle, pulling income, asset, and employment data, cross-validating against regulatory requirements, running risk scenarios, and generating the credit decision with full documentation. Approval cycles compress from weeks to days.

From objective to outcome

This is how banking operations transform.

Finacle, Temenos, FIS, Finastra, Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, your KYC registry, your AML platform, your regulatory reporting system connect what you have. Nothing migrates. Your data stays in your sovereign cloud environment.

Zero rip-and-replace — not a core banking replacement, the intelligence layer that makes every system you run work toward your business and compliance objectives.

Not a process improvement. A goal. “Reduce KYC onboarding from 21 days to 48 hours.” “Cut loan origination costs by 40% without increasing credit risk.” The OS returns a ranked execution plan by process, by risk, by regulatory requirement with reasoning attached.

Objective-first. Compliant by design. Regulators get the audit trail they require.

From 400+ agents, the OS calls what’s relevant: KYC verification, fraud triage, credit underwriting, compliance monitoring, customer service, dispute resolution. Autonomy is defined by process type: assistive for credit-adjacent decisions, delegated for KYC refresh, autonomous for tier-1 fraud blocks.

Staged autonomy · Earned, not assumed. Governance answered with an architecture, not a policy document.

Customers get onboarded. Loans get approved. Fraud gets caught. The OS tracks every outcome against your business objective, and every decision is explainable, at the moment it was made, to whoever asks.

Explainable at execution · Auditable always. Institutional knowledge stays in the system.

Why Lyzr

Your data. Your agents. Your call. Always.

Sovereign, governed and model-agnostic by design, so every agent and every workflow stays yours.

Stays in your environment

Amadeo deploys in your cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or on-premise. No data leaves. No training on your proprietary information. 80% of enterprise deployments choose private cloud.

Governed at every step

Every agent action is logged. Every output validated. Human-in-the-loop controls for every decision that matters. SOC 2 Type II. GDPR-ready. EU AI Act compliant path.

No lock-in. Ever.

What you build on Amadeo belongs to you. Walk away with every agent, every workflow, every intelligence layer fully intact. We are the infrastructure, not the owner of what you create on it.

Any model. Any framework.

OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source. LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce. Amadeo runs them all under one control plane. You’re never dependent on one provider’s roadmap.
